description: Plan a short vertical video from an idea: a hook line, a 4–6 beat structure with time ranges, caption tips and a call to action, plus a link to the Veedio tool page that can make it. Deterministic and instant. Use it when someone wants to plan, outline or script a TikTok, Reel or Short.

idea.description: What the video is about, in the person's own words — e.g. 'why octopuses are so smart'.

seconds.description: Length of the video in seconds: 30, 60 (the default) or 90.

name: short_video_outline
title: Outline a short video
